Name: Hatsune Miku Visual Overhaul
Author: CoriMods
Description:
[size=3]Hatsune miku is back with an updated look for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29201]Miku Mod Plus[/url] 💙🎵﻿

Her updated look is still based on her V2 design.
There are future plans for seasonal outfits, which will be based on her rhythm games outfits.

If there are any issues with the mod, please let me know! 
But also keep in mind that some you may encounter will likely be from 'Miku Mod Plus' and as such should be reported there. 

[/size]
[size=4][b]‧₊˚✧[u]HOW TO INSTALL[/u]✧˚₊‧
[/b][/size][size=3]
Copy and paste the [CP] Hatsune Miku Visual Overhaul folder into your mods folder
[/size][size=3][b](NOTE: Not compatible with other Hatsune Miku mods)[/b]
